title: Icon buttons
description: Icon-only buttons across the Taskscape screens: window traffic lights and Windows/Linux window controls, list tab and project controls, search-bar and row action buttons, toolbar buttons, inspector header actions, filter panel, lightbox, settings and trash controls. The 93 source rows are grouped into 50 variants by look and behaviour; widgets that act differently are kept apart (for example, the inert traffic lights and the close, minimise and full-screen lights).

variants.name: Traffic light, close, enabled
variants.description: Red macOS window traffic light that closes the window (or the Settings window). Rows: title-bar close, main-window close (same disc as the title-bar row, bundled in the main-window row), settings-capture close, settings-about close. The main-window row and the title-bar row are the same control on different screens.
variants.look: 14x14 disc (title-bar box 14x14 at 18,15); button size-4 (16px) containing svg viewBox 85.4; lit ring #e24b41, fill #ed6a5f, glyph #460804; glyph X fades in on hover. The oklch(0.26 0.012 262) value recorded in the main-window and Trash rows is not used for this glyph: it sits beside font settings and is probably the text colour (unverified).
states: unlit when window blurred (inactive colours, no glyph)
variants.behaviour: Click closes the window. Title-bar calls win.close() (WindowControls.tsx:139). Disabled only if the action is missing.

variants.name: Traffic light, minimise, enabled

variants.look: 14x14 disc at 39,15; button size-4; svg viewBox 85.4; lit ring #e1a73e, fill #f6be50, glyph #90591d; minus glyph on hover.
variants.behaviour: Click calls win.minimize() (WindowControls.tsx:140).

variants.name: Traffic light, full screen, enabled

variants.look: 14x14 disc at 60,15; button size-4; svg viewBox 85.4; lit ring #2dac2f, fill #61c555, glyph #2a6218; diagonal-arrows glyph on hover.
variants.behaviour: Click reads win.isFullscreen() then calls win.setFullscreen(!f) (WindowControls.tsx:141-142).

variants.behaviour: Click calls onClose and closes the Trash pane (close target not confirmed; handler supplied by parent).

variants.name: Search options, tune icon (target unverified)
variants.description: Tune icon in the search bar that opens search options. Merged from two rows with the same button at the same position. The click target is unverified: main-window (inferred) reads it as opening the Filter and Sort panel, while task-list reads it as opening the search-options scope menu below the button. Draft-inspector and multi-inspector targets are also unverified. The filter-panel and trash tune rows are not assigned here until their targets are confirmed.

variants.name: Close split view, search bar

states: shown only when split is on (not in any recorded task-list state)
variants.behaviour: Click closes split view. Task-list calls layoutStore.closeSplit(); main-window handler not in these files (unverified).

variants.name: Subtask expand chevron, button
variants.component: button (raw element); the bare icon row is the same control
variants.description: Expand or collapse button on a parent row in the task list, left of the subtask counter. Merged with the bare chevron icon at the same position (771,246), which has the same colour, size and -90 rotation when expanded. Hover-only when expanded; always visible when collapsed; hidden when the row has no visible children (search typed).
variants.look: Button [770,245,18,18], radius 4.375px; grid h-5 w-5; icon span [771,246,16,16] font 400 16px/16px, iconWeight 300; colour oklch(0.62 0.013 264) light / oklch(0.57 0.011 262) dark; transition-transform duration-100.
states: expanded (rotated -90, shown on row hover only)
hidden when the row has no visible children
variants.behaviour: Click toggles the row in the collapsed set and stops propagation; double-click stopped. The bare icon row reads as a toggle too (not confirmed in these files).
